result.verdictRationale: Reference properties show an effective historical rate of ₹12.84/kWh across 190 kW connected capacity (133.59 MWh/yr). Dhun's working assumption of 300 MWh/yr is bill-derived (₹2.5L/mo @ ₹10/kWh) and represents an unmetered site. Denominators (floor area, guest days) are external and cannot be directly equated without verified physical meters.
recommendations: Conduct a physical utility meter audit at Dhun 11kV Substation to establish an empirical baseline.
Calibrate working tariff assumption: historical reference bills indicate ₹12.84/kWh all-in cost vs working assumption of ₹10.00/kWh (+28.4% variance).
Do not normalize kWh/m² using external property benchmarks without documented architectural floor plans.
